analysis: The only change in this file is at line 313 of EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift: the test helper `recordServerStream` now ignores `.logprobs` events alongside `.toolCall` and `.toolCallDelta`. This is test-only code. It adds no production code path, no coordinator or provider wire change, and no change to authorization, attestation, encryption or cache storage. I read the two supplied head-text units (lines 654-1810). They contain unchanged test scaffolding for KV re-slicing, heartbeat capacity, request routing, and tool-choice enforcement. These tests assert existing behavior: fail-closed forced tool_choice, rejection of multimodal requests with forced tool_choice, and no prompt-derived data on the wire. The T-041 prefix-cache and SSD-tier surface is not touched; the tests cover only engine KV grants and the paged-pool residue diagnostics. Residual question for the integration pass: the production enum that gains a `.logprobs` case (MLXServerGenerationEvent) lives outside this batch. Whether logprobs reach the consumer only via the encrypted response path (T-008, A-001) cannot be judged from this test file, so the next pass should check that source where the case is introduced. No security regression is identified in the supplied units.
